framework: Exact integer-pool ledger (solver/encode.py semantics): T7 +6 LATENT per sited A-event; T5 mobilizes min(LATENT,2) per firing event (P_all fires everywhere; B-phase has no injection); T6 pays min(ACTIVE,need). result_CASE_A_CLOSED.proof: B-phase mobilization M_B = min(L0,2*e_B) = 2*e_B exactly (greedy per-event, no B-injection). result_REDUCTION_PROVED.proof: M_B = L0 exactly, so ACTIVE_pre = A0+L0 = 6*S_A - paid_so_far by conservation (IH: paid=need at all prior KEEPs). ACTIVE_pre >= need_j iff 6*S_A(j) >= sum_{i<=j} need_i. The full node therefore reduces exactly to the cumulative lemma below.
